request.business_problem: Accounts payable compares supplier invoices against purchase orders by eye and misses quantity, price and tax differences that cost us money.
request.tasks: Given a pasted supplier invoice and the matching purchase order, list every mismatch (item, quantity, unit price, tax, totals), say whether to approve, query or reject, and draft a short query email to the supplier.
request.required_output: A mismatch table, a recommendation (approve / query supplier / reject) and a draft email.
request.examples: PO-7781: 40 x Olive oil 5L @ 21.50. Invoice INV-2290 bills 44 x Olive oil 5L @ 21.50 and 12% tax instead of 8%.

smoke.prompt: Check this invoice against the PO. PO-100: 10 x Rice 25kg @ 18.00. Invoice INV-9: 12 x Rice 25kg @ 18.00, tax 8%, total 233.28.
